theta.Description: Theta-band power density at this channel (Welch method). Confirmed linear power (not dB) from pop_eegstats source code.

alpha.Description: Alpha-band power density at this channel (Welch method). Confirmed linear power (not dB).

beta.Description: Beta-band power density at this channel (Welch method, 1st otherrange). Confirmed linear power (not dB).

gamma.Description: Gamma-band power density at this channel (Welch method, 2nd otherrange). Confirmed linear power (not dB).

alpha_peak_freq_hz.Description: Per-channel individual alpha frequency (IAF): eegstats.restingIAF.iafChan.peaks (confirmed field name from pop_eegstats source code). NaN if this channel did not meet the iafminchan validity criterion.
